title: Unlocking Post-hoc Dataset Inference with Synthetic Data
paper_type_zh: 合成参考集与数据集推断配方
best_for_zh: 研究训练数据溯源、membership inference、统计校准和审计证据边界的读者
one_line: Shared-prefix synthetic suffixes and calibrated paired tests enable post-hoc set-level training-data inference without a pre-existing matched holdout.
该工作通过同前缀合成后缀与校准配对检验，在缺少天然匹配留出集时进行事后集合级训练数据推断，但不能给出记录级或法律层面的证明。
why: The method turns a missing-heldout problem in provenance audits into an explicit data-construction and calibration recipe, while its result remains conditional aggregate evidence rather than record-level lineage or legal proof.
inclusion_reason: The work gives a concrete recipe for constructing synthetic reference data when a trustworthy matched holdout does not exist, and couples that construction with distribution-gap calibration, false-positive controls, open code, and a released Pile-derived artifact.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official ICML 2025 paper asks how a data owner can test whether an LLM was trained on a suspect text collection when no trustworthy, matched non-member set was reserved. Conventional dataset inference compares target-model membership features on suspect and known non-member data. Even slight topic, date, or document shifts can be mistaken for membership: on a 1,400-post single-author corpus, the original method reports p-values between 0.001 and 0.002 for post sets known not to be members.

This work belongs in data_construction_open_release_recipes because its central artifact is a recipe for manufacturing the missing reference set. One audit instance begins with suspect documents, segments and shuffles them, trains a generator on one sequence partition, and turns a shared prefix from another partition into a natural-suffix/synthetic-suffix pair. Target-model membership features and two classifier probabilities are then compared statistically.

The method does not establish record-level lineage, identify an exact training checkpoint or date, or decide ownership and infringement. Its result is a set-level hypothesis test conditional on the generator, target-model access, feature extractor, classifier, split, and significance threshold. The paper, appendix, code, and released Pile-derived archive support a detailed Card, but missing immutable versions, data licensing, checkpoints, and paper-run configuration justify retaining partial status and L3_summary_ready rather than upgrading curation state.

ICML 2025 官方论文研究的问题是：当数据所有者没有预留可信且分布匹配的非成员集合时，如何检验某个 LLM 是否用过一组可疑文本。传统 dataset inference 会比较可疑数据与已知非成员数据上的目标模型 membership feature；即便只有轻微的话题、日期或文档差异，也可能被误判为成员信号。在一个含 1,400 篇文章的单作者语料上，原始方法对已知非成员文章仍给出 0.001 到 0.002 的 p-value。

该工作属于 data_construction_open_release_recipes，因为其核心 artifact 是“构造缺失参考集”的配方。一次审计从可疑文档开始，先分段并打乱，在一个序列分区上训练 generator，再用另一分区中的共享 prefix 构造“自然 suffix—合成 suffix”配对；随后统计比较目标模型 membership feature 与两个 classifier 的概率。

该方法不能建立记录级 lineage，不能识别精确训练 checkpoint 或日期，也不能裁决所有权与侵权。其结论是一个受 generator、目标模型访问方式、feature extractor、classifier、split 和显著性阈值共同约束的集合级假设检验。论文、附录、代码与发布的 Pile 衍生 archive 足以支持详细 Card，但 immutable version、数据许可证、checkpoint 和论文运行配置仍缺失，因此保持 partial 与 L3_summary_ready，不升级 curation state。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a calibrated synthetic-reference interface for dataset inference. Each natural suffix and generated suffix share the same prefix, reducing position and local-context differences. A text-only classifier measures the remaining natural-versus-generated gap. A combined classifier sees the same text together with likelihood-derived membership-inference features from the target model. The feedback contract asks whether the combined classifier's paired separation is greater than the text-only separation; repeated one-sided tests are aggregated with Sidak correction, and p below 0.05 is treated as set-level membership evidence.

This interface observes aggregate separability in text space and target-model score space. It does not observe the target model's actual training manifest, cannot prove membership for an individual suffix, and cannot distinguish authorization or legal status. Failure to reject the null is inconclusive rather than evidence of absence.

The closest predecessor is LLM Dataset Inference: Did you train on my dataset?, which aggregates membership-inference signals but assumes a matched held-out set. The present paper replaces that unavailable object with suffix-completed synthetic references and adds post-hoc generation-gap calibration plus positive feature weights. Its direction is therefore provenance auditing through constructed evaluation data, not reasoning-trace training or process supervision.

本文的贡献是一种用于 dataset inference 的“校准合成参考集”接口。每个自然 suffix 与生成 suffix 共享同一个 prefix，从而缩小位置与局部上下文差异。text-only classifier 测量剩余的自然—生成分布差距；combined classifier 则同时接收文本与由目标模型似然导出的 membership-inference feature。feedback contract 检验 combined classifier 的配对区分能力是否高于纯文本区分能力；多次单侧检验的 p-value 通过 Sidak correction 聚合，低于 0.05 时被视为集合级成员证据。

这个接口能观察文本空间与目标模型 score 空间中的总体可分性，但看不到目标模型真实的训练 manifest，无法证明单个 suffix 的成员身份，也无法判断授权或法律状态。未能拒绝 null hypothesis 只能算 inconclusive，不能作为“未使用”的证据。

最接近的前序工作是 LLM Dataset Inference: Did you train on my dataset?：它聚合 membership-inference signal，但假定存在匹配 held-out set。本文用 suffix-completed synthetic reference 替换这一现实中常缺失的对象，并加入生成差距的 post-hoc calibration 与正向 feature weight。因此，该方向属于通过构造评测数据开展 provenance audit，而不是 reasoning trace training 或 process supervision。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are suspect natural-language documents and a target causal language model. The single-author experiment collects 1,400 posts, removes figures, tables, videos, hyperlinks, and other non-text elements, and uses 450 posts as known members for one-epoch LoRA fine-tuning of deduplicated Pythia-410M. The Pile experiments treat train as member and combined validation/test as non-member. Selected subsets cover web, academic, biomedical, legal, code, email, multilingual, and chat text; four subsets described as potentially copyright-problematic are excluded.

For reference construction, documents are segmented into short sequences, capped per source document, shuffled, and split at sequence level. The paper reserves 2,000 sequences for generator inference and trains on the remainder; the repository additionally assigns indices 2,000–3,999 to generator validation. Meta Llama 3 8B is LoRA-finetuned by next-token prediction. Each inference sequence is divided at a shared prefix: its natural continuation becomes the suspect suffix, and the generator completion becomes the synthetic held-out suffix. Pile configurations use 32 or 64 tokens and per-document caps chosen by subset; the authors recommend selecting token length where the text-classifier AUC is smallest.

The generator uses LoRA rank 32, 100 epochs, 0.03 warm-up ratio, and a linear scheduler. The rendered appendix omits the numeric learning rate. Generation temperature, decoding budget, random seeds, exact target checkpoints, and paper-run outlier fractions remain unknown. The public Pile archive is described as four JSONL files per subset: member original, member generated, non-member original, and non-member generated. text stores clean text and additional entries store augmentations.

Calibration begins by splitting paired suspect and synthetic data into classifier-training and test portions. A randomly initialized two-layer GPT2-style text classifier receives only text; a combined classifier receives text plus target-model MIA features such as likelihood-derived scores. Both train for 20 epochs, while a positive-weight linear membership layer trains for 200 epochs. Positivity is enforced through a sigmoid parameterization so an inverted generation artifact cannot acquire a negative weight and mimic membership.

For each natural/generated pair, the pipeline computes a text-only separation and a combined separation. A one-sided difference-comparison t-test asks whether adding target-model membership features improves separation. The test is repeated under different random splits and combined with Sidak family-wise correction. At 0.05, rejection supports aggregate membership; non-rejection is inconclusive. The paper trains each classifier on 1,000 natural plus 1,000 synthetic items and tests on another equally sized paired set; it equates total test sample count with target-model queries.

Reproduction requires pinning the target-model weights, Meta Llama 3 8B revision, source-corpus snapshot, segmentation and caps, sequence shuffle, generator split, LoRA and decoding settings, MIA feature list, outlier policy, classifier architecture, random splits, test direction, and multiplicity correction. The current repository loads target weights locally and has no tagged release, so it does not establish operation through a closed sampled-text-only API.

输入是可疑自然语言文档与一个目标 causal language model。单作者实验收集 1,400 篇文章，去除图、表、视频、超链接及其他非文本元素，并以其中 450 篇作为已知 member，对 deduplicated Pythia-410M 做一轮 LoRA fine-tuning。Pile 实验把 train 视为 member，把 validation/test 合并后视为 non-member。所选 subset 覆盖网页、学术、生物医学、法律、代码、邮件、多语种与聊天文本；论文排除了四个被描述为可能存在版权问题的 subset。

构造参考集时，先把文档切成短序列，限制每篇来源文档的序列数，打乱后按 sequence level 划分。论文为 generator inference 预留 2,000 条序列，其余用于训练；仓库还把索引 2,000–3,999 分配给 generator validation。Meta Llama 3 8B 通过 next-token prediction 做 LoRA fine-tuning。每条 inference sequence 在共享 prefix 处分开：自然 continuation 成为可疑 suffix，generator completion 成为合成 held-out suffix。Pile 配置使用 32 或 64 token，并按 subset 设置每文档上限；作者建议选择使 text-classifier AUC 最低的 token length。

generator 使用 LoRA rank 32、100 个 epoch、0.03 warm-up ratio 和 linear scheduler。渲染后的附录没有显示数值 learning rate；generation temperature、decoding budget、随机 seed、精确 target checkpoint 与论文运行所用 outlier fraction 仍是 unknown。公开 Pile archive 被描述为每个 subset 四个 JSONL：member original、member generated、non-member original 与 non-member generated。text 保存 clean text，其他 entry 保存 augmentation。

校准先把配对的可疑数据与合成数据划分为 classifier training 与 test 部分。随机初始化的两层 GPT2-style text classifier 只接收文本；combined classifier 同时接收文本和目标模型的 MIA feature，例如基于 likelihood 的 score。两类 classifier 训练 20 个 epoch，正权重 linear membership layer 训练 200 个 epoch。正权重通过 sigmoid parameterization 约束，避免方向相反的生成 artifact 获得负权重并伪装成 membership。

对每组自然/生成 pair，流水线计算 text-only separation 与 combined separation。单侧 difference-comparison t-test 检验加入目标模型 membership feature 后，区分能力是否增强。检验在不同随机划分下重复，并用 Sidak family-wise correction 聚合。阈值为 0.05：拒绝 null hypothesis 支持集合级 membership，未拒绝则只能算 inconclusive。论文用 1,000 条自然样本和 1,000 条合成样本训练每个 classifier，再以另一组等规模配对数据做检验；总 test sample count 被等同于目标模型 query 数。

复现时必须固定目标模型权重、Meta Llama 3 8B revision、来源语料 snapshot、分段与上限、sequence shuffle、generator split、LoRA 与 decoding setting、MIA feature list、outlier policy、classifier architecture、随机划分、检验方向及多重比较 correction。当前仓库在本地加载目标模型权重且没有 tagged release，因此不能证明它能通过 closed sampled-text-only API 运行。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The motivating failure is quantitative. On known non-member blog posts, conventional DI reports p-values of 0.002, 0.001, 0.001, 0.001, and 0.001 as the cap rises from 5 to 25 sequences per blog, falsely declaring membership in all five settings (Table 1). With the complete proposed pipeline, the single-author member set gives text-only/combined AUC 53.8/55.6 and p=0.01, while the non-member set gives 53.8/53.9 and p=0.13, yielding the intended member/non-member decisions (Table 3).

Suffix completion is the closest synthetic match among the generation methods tested. In Table 2, BoW/GPT2 AUC is 76.2/99.0 for ICL paraphrasing, 79.2/99.2 for ICL text completion, 50.2/58.9 for preference optimization, and 50.0/52.2 for suffix completion. These AUCs quantify distinguishability between natural and synthetic text; values near 50 do not prove semantic correctness, absence of memorization, or dataset rights.

On 16 Pile subsets with deduplicated Pythia-1B, every displayed member p-value is at most 0.04 and every non-member value is above 0.05, so Table 4 makes the correct binary decision for all displayed rows. The safety margin is uneven: non-member p-values are 0.06 for StackExchange, 0.07 for Github and EuroParl, and 0.09 for FreeLaw. Thus the surrounding prose claim that all non-member values exceed 0.1 is not supported by its own table. Appendix results also show correct decisions across Pythia 410M, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 6.9B, plus OLMo-7B on Wikipedia and Common Crawl, but remain within controlled known-split experiments.

Table 5 supplies both false-negative and false-positive ablations. ICL paraphrasing, ICL completion, preference optimization, no segment-and-shuffle, and no suffix comparison all give p=1.0 for member and non-member sets, missing membership. Without post-hoc calibration, both member and non-member produce p below 0.001, a false positive for the non-member set. The complete method gives p below 0.001 for the member and 1.0 for the non-member in that Pile ablation. Removing the weight constraint gives 0.004 and 0.43, which is correct in this aggregate case but weaker than the authors' constrained setting.

Figure 5 reports that fewer than 1,000 total queries reach significance for most datasets, while 2,000 total paired queries give the strongest consistency across all evaluated member sets. This is a power result under the paper's datasets and feature pipeline, not a guaranteed query budget for arbitrary models. The code and released JSONL archive increase auditability, but no independent reproduction is reported in the checked official artifacts.

动机中的 failure 有明确数值。在已知 non-member 博客上，传统 DI 随每篇文章序列上限从 5 增至 25，分别给出 0.002、0.001、0.001、0.001 和 0.001 的 p-value，五个 setting 全部误判为 member（表 1）。完整方法在单作者 member set 上得到 53.8/55.6 的 text-only/combined AUC 与 p=0.01；non-member set 则为 53.8/53.9 与 p=0.13，因此得到预期的 member/non-member 判断（表 3）。

在所测生成方法中，suffix completion 与自然文本最接近。表 2 中，ICL paraphrasing 的 BoW/GPT2 AUC 为 76.2/99.0，ICL text completion 为 79.2/99.2，preference optimization 为 50.2/58.9，suffix completion 为 50.0/52.2。这些 AUC 衡量自然文本与合成文本的可区分性；接近 50 并不能证明语义正确、没有 memorization 或拥有数据权利。

在 16 个 Pile subset 和 deduplicated Pythia-1B 上，所有展示的 member p-value 都不高于 0.04，所有 non-member 值都高于 0.05，因此表 4 的每一行都作出正确二元判断。但安全余量不均匀：StackExchange 的 non-member p-value 为 0.06，Github 与 EuroParl 为 0.07，FreeLaw 为 0.09。所以，正文所称“所有 non-member 都高于 0.1”并不受其表格支持。附录还在 Pythia 410M、1.4B、2.8B、6.9B，以及 OLMo-7B 的 Wikipedia 与 Common Crawl 上给出正确判断，但仍属于受控的已知 split 实验。

表 5 同时给出 false-negative 与 false-positive ablation。ICL paraphrasing、ICL completion、preference optimization、去掉 segment-and-shuffle、去掉 suffix comparison 时，member 与 non-member 的 p-value 都为 1.0，因而漏掉 membership。去掉 post-hoc calibration 时，member 与 non-member 都得到低于 0.001 的 p-value，对 non-member 形成 false positive。完整方法在该 Pile ablation 中对 member 给出低于 0.001，对 non-member 给出 1.0。去掉 weight constraint 后为 0.004 与 0.43，在这一汇总实验中仍判断正确，但弱于作者的约束设定。

图 5 报告：少于 1,000 次总 query 时，多数数据集已达到显著性；2,000 次总配对 query 时，所有评测 member set 的一致性最强。这是受论文数据集与 feature pipeline 约束的 power result，不是对任意模型都成立的 query budget 保证。代码和 JSONL archive 提高了可审计性，但所检查的官方 artifact 没有提供独立复现结果。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier LLM dataset inference aggregates membership features over a suspect set but relies on a real held-out set that is both known absent from training and distribution-matched. The paper's failure study shows why that assumption is fragile even for randomly shuffled writings by one author. Blind-baseline work had already established that distribution shift can dominate membership attacks, and the post-hoc correction is inspired by prior debiasing work; neither dataset inference nor distribution calibration is introduced from scratch here.

The concrete change is the evaluation object: a shared prefix produces paired natural and synthetic suffixes, and the audit compares a text-only generation-gap model with a text-plus-membership model. Segment-and-shuffle keeps generator training and inference snippets close in distribution, positive weights constrain how likelihood features contribute, and a repeated corrected test yields a set-level decision. The novelty is this combination of synthetic-reference construction and calibrated feedback, not simply using Llama 3 or increasing scale.

For reasoning-data research, the direction matters because it treats provenance checking as a designed data pipeline with explicit negative controls. It offers a pattern for auditing whether a corpus may have influenced a model when no prospective holdout exists. Before reuse, however, practitioners still need a legally reusable corpus, immutable artifact versions, a supported target-model interface, and power/false-positive calibration for their own generator and domain.

此前的 LLM dataset inference 会在可疑集合上聚合 membership feature，但依赖一个确定未参与训练且分布匹配的真实 held-out set。本文的 failure study 表明，即便把同一作者的文章随机打乱，这一假设也很脆弱。Blind-baseline 工作已经说明 distribution shift 可能支配 membership attack，post-hoc correction 也借鉴了已有的去偏方法；因此，dataset inference 与 distribution calibration 都不是本文从零提出的组件。

真正改变的是 evaluation object：共享 prefix 产生配对的自然 suffix 与合成 suffix，审计再比较 text-only generation-gap model 和 text-plus-membership model。segment-and-shuffle 让 generator training 与 inference snippet 在分布上更接近，正权重约束 likelihood feature 的作用方向，多次校正检验给出集合级决定。新意在于 synthetic-reference construction 与 calibrated feedback 的组合，而不是简单使用 Llama 3 或扩大规模。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，这一方向的重要性在于把 provenance checking 视为带明确 negative control 的数据流水线。当不存在预先留出的 holdout 时，它为审计某个语料是否可能影响模型提供了范式。但在复用前，实践者仍需确认语料可合法复用、artifact 有 immutable version、目标模型接口受支持，并在自己的 generator 与领域上重新校准 statistical power 和 false-positive behavior。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Methodologically, the test is conditional rather than identificational. It assumes that text-only classification captures generation artifacts while the combined classifier's incremental advantage isolates membership. Hidden correlations between text features and likelihood features can violate that decomposition. Generator memorization, domain mismatch, feature selection, outlier handling, and classifier capacity can alter both false positives and false negatives. A synthetic set that is too distinguishable hides membership, while uncalibrated likelihood gaps fabricate it.

The evaluation does not establish a uniform margin. Although every main-table row lies on the intended side of 0.05, several non-member p-values are 0.06–0.09, and the paper's claim that all exceed 0.1 conflicts with Table 4. Results use known Pile splits, one single-author corpus, deduplicated Pythia checkpoints, and two OLMo subsets. Cross-domain generalization to closed commercial models, unknown training mixtures, adversarially selected suspect sets, other generators, or weaker memorization remains unverified. Choosing token length by observed text-classifier AUC may also introduce analysis flexibility unless fixed prospectively (curator inference).

The target-model access boundary is narrower than the broad legal narrative. Current code loads model weights and calculates token-likelihood-derived MIA features. It does not show that the method works with a closed service that only returns sampled text. Statistical rejection is aggregate evidence under an assumed checkpoint and training-ground-truth setup; it does not reveal which records were used, when they were used, whether use was authorized, or whether legal infringement occurred. Non-rejection is not proof of absence.

Release completeness is partial. The repository is MIT licensed, but the linked Google Drive data has no explicit dataset license or consolidated upstream rights statement. The mutable archive lacks an author checksum and version manifest; checkpoints are not released, the repository has no tagged release, and the README's data-release update conflicts with its stale unfinished-items list. Paper-run learning rate, decoding parameters, seeds, outlier fractions, complete hardware/compute cost, and exact revisions are missing.

Sequence-level splitting is intentionally distribution-matching but places snippets from the same source document across generator partitions, so it is not document-independent evaluation. Excluding selected Pile subsets described as copyright-problematic does not establish license, privacy, or consent for retained material. Releasing synthetic continuations derived from suspect documents may itself require a source- and jurisdiction-specific rights review (curator inference).

从方法上看，该检验是 conditional，而不是直接 identification。它假定 text-only classification 能捕获生成 artifact，combined classifier 的增量优势则隔离 membership；文本 feature 与 likelihood feature 的隐藏相关性可能破坏这种分解。generator memorization、domain mismatch、feature selection、outlier handling 与 classifier capacity 都会改变 false positive 和 false negative。合成集合过于可区分时会掩盖 membership，未校准的 likelihood gap 又会伪造成员信号。

评测没有建立统一安全余量。虽然主表每一行都位于 0.05 阈值的预期一侧，但若干 non-member p-value 只有 0.06–0.09，论文所称“全部高于 0.1”与表 4 冲突。结果依赖已知 Pile split、一个单作者语料、deduplicated Pythia checkpoint 和两个 OLMo subset；对 closed commercial model、未知训练 mixture、对抗性选择的 suspect set、其他 generator 或较弱 memorization 的泛化仍未验证。按观察到的 text-classifier AUC 选择 token length，若未预先固定，也可能带来 analysis flexibility（curator inference）。

目标模型访问边界比论文的广泛法律叙事更窄。当前代码会加载模型权重并计算基于 token likelihood 的 MIA feature，没有证明方法可用于只返回 sampled text 的 closed service。统计拒绝是在假定 checkpoint 与训练 ground truth 下的集合级证据；它不能说明具体用了哪些记录、何时使用、是否授权或是否构成法律侵权。未拒绝也不能证明不存在使用。

release 完整性仍是 partial。代码仓库采用 MIT license，但所链接的 Google Drive 数据没有明确 dataset license 或统一 upstream rights statement。可变 archive 缺少作者 checksum 与 version manifest；checkpoint 未发布，仓库没有 tagged release，README 的数据发布 update 与其过时的 unfinished-items list 相互矛盾。论文运行的 learning rate、decoding parameter、seed、outlier fraction、完整 hardware/compute cost 与精确 revision 也缺失。

sequence-level splitting 有意追求分布匹配，但会让同一来源文档的 snippet 跨越 generator partition，因此不属于 document-independent evaluation。排除若干被描述为版权风险较高的 Pile subset，也不能证明保留材料的 license、privacy 或 consent 状态。发布由可疑文档衍生的 synthetic continuation 本身可能还需要按来源与司法辖区审查权利（curator inference）。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the data_construction_open_release_recipes track, this paper supplies an executable audit-data pattern: create matched natural/synthetic suffix pairs, measure the generator gap explicitly, add target-model features only in a second classifier, and retain known-member and known-non-member controls. A new reasoning-data release could adopt that structure to test possible training influence while logging prefix identity, source document, generator revision, MIA features, outlier decisions, random split, and corrected p-values.

The work is suitable as an evaluation and audit reference, a baseline for synthetic-holdout construction, and a failure-analysis checklist for distribution-shift-driven false accusations. It is not presently safe as a training-data release: the Google Drive archive lacks an explicit license and immutable manifest, and its rows are Pile-derived. It is also not a turnkey black-box audit for proprietary APIs because the implementation expects local likelihood access.

A responsible reuse should preregister the suspect set, generator and target checkpoint, token length, feature family, outlier rule, number of random runs, significance threshold, and multiplicity correction; run both positive and negative controls; report power and effect sizes alongside p-values; and avoid turning rejection into record-level or legal claims. The most useful replication would test independent generators, document-level splits, deliberately shifted negative controls, and text-only API constraints.

对 data_construction_open_release_recipes track 而言，本文提供了可执行的 audit-data pattern：构造匹配的自然/合成 suffix pair，显式测量 generator gap，只在第二个 classifier 中加入目标模型 feature，并保留已知 member 与已知 non-member control。新的 reasoning-data release 可以采用这一结构来测试潜在训练影响，同时记录 prefix identity、source document、generator revision、MIA feature、outlier decision、随机 split 与校正后的 p-value。

该工作适合作为 evaluation/audit reference、synthetic-holdout construction baseline，以及分析 distribution shift 所致错误指控的 failure checklist。当前 archive 不适合作为可直接安全训练复用的数据 release：Google Drive artifact 没有明确许可证与 immutable manifest，且 row 衍生自 Pile。它也不是面向 proprietary API 的即用型 black-box audit，因为实现依赖本地 likelihood access。

负责任的复用应预先固定 suspect set、generator 与 target checkpoint、token length、feature family、outlier rule、随机运行次数、显著性阈值与 multiplicity correction；同时运行 positive/negative control；在 p-value 之外报告 power 与 effect size；并避免把拒绝 null hypothesis 扩张为记录级或法律主张。最有价值的复现会测试独立 generator、document-level split、刻意引入 shift 的 negative control，以及 text-only API 限制。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start with Table 1: it demonstrates why a seemingly matched same-author holdout can still create a severe false positive.
  • Read Figure 3 with Algorithm 1; the crucial object is a shared-prefix natural/generated suffix pair created after sequence-level shuffling.
  • Treat the dual-classifier difference test as the feedback contract, and remember that non-rejection is inconclusive.
  • Compare Table 2 and Table 5: a larger generation gap causes false negatives, while removing calibration causes false positives.
  • Check Table 4 rather than its surrounding prose; several non-member p-values are 0.06–0.09, not above 0.1.
  • Read alongside LLM Dataset Inference: Did you train on my dataset? and verify archive license, revisions, checkpoints, target access, and preregistered statistics before reuse.

value.html: Suspect natural-language documents are segmented into short sequences, shuffled, capped per document, and split at sequence rather than document level. Experiments use 1,400 posts from one author and selected Pile subsets; Pile train supplies known members and validation plus test supplies known non-members.

Each comparison object is an original natural suffix paired with a generated suffix that shares its prefix. Released Pile directories contain member and non-member original JSONL files plus generated counterparts; text stores clean text and other entries store text augmentations.

Natural suspect suffixes come from source documents. A Meta Llama 3 8B generator, LoRA-finetuned on other shuffled sequences from the same suspect corpus, completes a shared prefix to produce a paired synthetic held-out suffix. These are text continuations, not reasoning traces.

Offline post-hoc dataset inference over a target causal language model. The released implementation loads model weights and computes token-likelihood-derived membership features; a sampled-text-only black-box contract is not demonstrated.

A text-only classifier estimates the natural-versus-synthetic distribution gap, while a combined classifier receives text plus target-model membership features. A one-sided difference-comparison t-test asks whether the combined classifier separates paired original/generated suffixes more strongly; repeated-run p-values are aggregated with Sidak correction.

At significance level 0.05, reject the null that target-model membership features add no detectable separation beyond the text-only generation gap. Rejection is set-level membership evidence under the test assumptions; failure to reject is inconclusive, not proof of non-use.
Reported target models include deduplicated Pythia 410M, 1B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 6.9B checkpoints and OLMo-7B.
unknown

Meta Llama 3 8B is LoRA-finetuned with next-token prediction on shuffled sequences from the suspect corpus, then completes shared prefixes to synthesize approximately in-distribution held-out suffixes.

The paper reserves 2,000 sequences for generator inference and uses the rest for generator training; the repository additionally assigns sequence indices 2,000–3,999 to validation. Per evaluated set, 1,000 suspect and 1,000 synthetic items train the classifiers and another equally sized paired sample supports the t-test. The released driver defaults to ten randomized runs.
unknown
unknown

Remove non-text elements from the single-author blogs; cap snippets per source document; limit Pile subset sequences to 32 or 64 tokens; choose token length to minimize text-classifier AUC; and handle target-model-feature outliers before calibration. Exact paper-run outlier fractions are incompletely rendered.

The paper equates total t-test sample size with target-model queries and reports the strongest cross-dataset consistency at 2,000 total queries, split equally between paired suspect and synthetic sets. Generation-token, compute, memory, and wall-clock budgets are unknown.

Generator LoRA rank 32, 100 epochs, warm-up ratio 0.03, and a linear scheduler are reported. Two-layer GPT2-style text and combined classifiers train for 20 epochs; the positive-weight linear membership layer trains for 200 epochs. The paper's rendered learning-rate value is unavailable, and generic script defaults do not pin the reported run.

One 1,400-post single-author blog corpus, including 450 known-member posts, plus selected Pile subsets spanning web text, forums, biomedical and legal text, papers, code, email, multilingual proceedings, and chat. OLMo experiments use Dolma v1.7 as known members and Paloma as known non-members.

Generator partitions are created after document segmentation and sequence shuffling, deliberately permitting snippets from one document in both generator training and inference. Pile train is treated as member and combined validation/test as non-member; classifier training and statistical testing use separate random portions of paired natural/generated data.

Blog posts published after the Pile collection cutoff are used as non-members for the Pythia experiment, and Pile split membership supplies ground truth for Pythia. No general record-level decontamination ledger, target-training manifest, or transformed-overlap audit is released.

items: Conventional dataset inference produces severe false positives under small suspect/held-out distribution shifts; the blog non-member control gives nominal p-values from 0.001 to 0.002 before the proposed repair.

A large natural-versus-synthetic text gap can hide the weaker membership signal and cause false negatives; ICL paraphrasing, ICL completion, preference optimization, and the no-segment/no-suffix ablations infer both sets as non-members.
Removing post-hoc calibration makes known member and known non-member sets significant, recreating a false positive; unconstrained feature weights can also exploit generation-direction artifacts.

Statistical power depends on set size, target-model memorization, generator quality, classifier architecture, token length, outlier handling, and random splits. A non-significant result cannot establish non-use.
Main-table non-member p-values include 0.06 for StackExchange and 0.07 for Github and EuroParl, so the paper prose claiming all non-member values exceed 0.1 overstates the displayed margin.
The implementation computes likelihood-derived features from locally loaded target models; applicability to closed models exposing only sampled text is not demonstrated.

A rejected null is aggregate statistical evidence under the tested assumptions, not proof that a particular record was used, nor proof of date, checkpoint, authorization, ownership, license breach, or legal infringement.
Sequence-level generator splitting improves distribution matching but does not provide document-independent generator evaluation.

The Google Drive release is mutable and lacks an author checksum, version manifest, released checkpoints, and an explicit dataset license. GitHub has no tagged release; the README's release update and unfinished-items list are internally stale about data availability.
Several Pile subsets described as potentially copyright-problematic are excluded, but that choice does not establish rights or consent for every retained source.
